name: GDEP ADVANCE,Inc.
summary: GDEP ADVANCE, Inc. is in the system incubation business in Japan. It distributes accelerator products such as XILINX FPGA boards and NVIDIA boards for graphics and computing, AI and GPU workstations, Infiniband network products, GPU servers, high-end storage such as NetApp and DDN solutions, and QNAP NAS storage. It also builds and operates systems to customer requests. Dating from 1978, it has its headquarters in Sendai, Japan.
